review:
Pelican Payday is a Pragmatic Play fishing slot in the Big Bass mould, with a pelican doing the collecting instead of a fisherman. Money symbols land with values of up to 1,000x, and in the base game a collect symbol on reel three instantly pays the value of every money symbol that landed on the same spin. There is no multiplier ladder here, just straightforward collecting.

Three scatters start eight free spins, which can be retriggered. During the feature collect symbols can land on any reel, and each one adds the value of all money symbols on screen to a pot before paying out the pot's current total, so later collects pay more than earlier ones. Try the free demo to see the pot build. It is a simpler, calmer money-collect slot than the Big Bass series, which makes it a good fit for players who find those games too feature-heavy.
